nodes.label: Controller input pipeline (device -> slot -> Button mask -> InputBuffer)
nodes.norm_label: controller input pipeline (device -> slot -> button mask -> inputbuffer)
nodes.rationale: Physical devices map to explicitly assigned local players producing the existing Button bitmask, so simulation, rollback and protocol code remained unchanged.

nodes.label: Standard mapping only for gameplay
nodes.rationale: Nonstandard devices remain visible and testable but cannot feed gameplay so they never trigger wrong attacks.

nodes.label: Rules for future controller UI
nodes.rationale: Use native elements with accessible names, stable IDs, data-nav-screen on screens, showModal() dialogs, never actions only on decorative divs; verify D-pad, stick, back, focus restoration and scrolling with the harness.

nodes.label: Shared spatial navigation
nodes.rationale: One navigation path for native buttons, links, selects, inputs and scroll regions so every screen behaves the same with D-pad and stick; confirm cycles selects instead of opening native popups that trap controller input.

nodes.label: Electron over Tauri decision
nodes.rationale: Bundled Chromium gives consistent WebGL, Canvas readback, eight-controller Gamepad API and Web Audio behavior; Tauri's system WebView2/WKWebView/WebKitGTK would add a compatibility matrix. Assets already dominate size so Electron's runtime overhead is acceptable.

nodes.label: Offline Barlow font bundling
nodes.rationale: The Google Fonts CSS import was an online dependency; licensed same-family font files are bundled so the desktop build works offline.

nodes.label: C1 Bozo clone-growth renderer crash (slots 7/8)
nodes.rationale: Only 18 strand bundles (6 players x 3) existed while gameplay permits 8 seats; fix provisions 8*3 bundles without touching animation math or simulation.

nodes.label: H1 Nikalz waves bypass recovery/escape protection
nodes.norm_label: h1 nikalz waves bypass recovery/escape protection
nodes.rationale: Wave eligibility used isActive/isInvulnerable and skipped the shared direct-hit recovery policy; fix makes PeriodicHit return whether a reaction applied and writes Nikalz private stun only when allowed, keeping damage and 120/360-frame stun durations.

nodes.label: M1 Bee swarm population limit
nodes.rationale: BeeSwarm had no expiry or capacity, growing collision work and rollback snapshots; a deterministic cap of 100 swarms per owner replacing the oldest was chosen as a resource-safety policy, not a balance value, and no expiry timer was added.

nodes.label: M3 Match-end cleanup omits Nikalz entities
nodes.norm_label: m3 match-end cleanup omits nikalz entities
nodes.rationale: Life cleanup cleared projectiles/hazards/clones/structures but not bees/waves, and advanceNikalz cleanup was unreachable after advanceFrame's result return; shared CombatLifecycle.clearCombatEntities now covers knockouts, tournament forfeits and elimination endings.

nodes.label: M6 Shared systems retain character identities
nodes.norm_label: m6 shared systems retain character identities
nodes.rationale: HairSystem hard-coded characterId==='bozo' and lifecycle policy was duplicated; narrow repair moves companion health ratio/offset into validated character definitions and shares terminal cleanup instead of rewriting combat.

nodes.label: drupa/motion-v8.png cross anatomy correction
nodes.rationale: Both cross poses had two arms on the same shoulder and a floating extended arm; v8 redraws only row2/row4 column2 with one continuous punching arm and a far guard fist.

nodes.label: Four-phase jab/cross animation
nodes.rationale: Replaces two-pose arm-only punches with startup/active/early-recovery phases returning to guard, using fixed anatomical scale per skin; gameplay timing and damage are unchanged.

nodes.label: Per-skin guard height and authored hip anchor scaling
nodes.norm_label: per-skin guard height and authored hip anchor scaling
nodes.rationale: Boxing previously measured scale against an unrelated row causing punches to shrink; every pose now uses its skin's guard height and a hip anchor.

nodes.label: Identity-preserve prompting from original atlases
nodes.rationale: The v6 walk and v4 boxing sheets drifted from original anatomy, so v7 was generated strictly from atlas-1/atlas-2 references and explicitly forbids using the drifted sheets as identity references.

nodes.label: White Buda Beam (steerable continuous beam)
nodes.rationale: Continuous damage deliberately does not pause the match, stun or push targets; up/down inputs steer the beam and aim state is replayable in the snapshot.

nodes.label: Hose lower-leg contact region (2.2x width, bottom 38%)
nodes.norm_label: hose lower-leg contact region (2.2x width, bottom 38%)
nodes.rationale: One shared test drives damage, knockback, training health retention and splash selection; the simulation ray ends at the same floor/arena boundary as the visible stream. Other beams keep their coverage.

nodes.label: StatusSystem hazard damage helper
nodes.community_name: L1 Hazard damage attribution uses burn owner

nodes.label: Caio (fighter)
nodes.community_name: L1 Hazard damage attribution uses burn owner

nodes.label: Caio poison dart (45 + 8x10 ticks, 20% slow)
nodes.community_name: L1 Hazard damage attribution uses burn owner
nodes.rationale: Armor applies to each poison tick; refreshes do not stack or postpone ticks.

nodes.label: Caio Sea of Blood (25s, 90% slow)
nodes.community_name: L1 Hazard damage attribution uses burn owner
nodes.rationale: Caster gains 20% movement speed while below the flood surface, giving the summoner an asymmetric advantage inside his own zone.

nodes.label: M5 Six unresolved regression failures
nodes.rationale: Balance/art/architecture changes were not reconciled with fixtures; only the 19 stale movement-facing baseline entries were updated after verifying zero trace changes. Never blindly regenerate golden hashes.

nodes.label: Movement-controlled facing
nodes.rationale: Left/right input sets facing and release preserves it; crossing, knockback and respawn no longer auto-turn. Fixed attack animations keep their direction while mobile abilities can turn. Approved control change superseding automatic facing.

nodes.label: Bounded desktop.log diagnostics
nodes.rationale: Rotates around 256 KiB, caps events per run, excludes room codes, inputs, secrets and identifiers; no upload or telemetry.

nodes.label: Renderer security policy (sandbox, CSP, no Node)
nodes.norm_label: renderer security policy (sandbox, csp, no node)
nodes.rationale: Sandbox, context isolation and web security on; Node, webviews, new windows, downloads and release devtools off; CSP allows only the configured relay; packaged files constrained to resources/game with traversal and symlink checks.

nodes.label: abroz://game secure origin
nodes.rationale: Root-relative /art and /audio fetches would break under file://, so the packaged client is served from a standard secure custom origin via a constrained protocol handler without a local HTTP server.

nodes.label: ALLOWED_ORIGINS must include abroz://game
nodes.rationale: Server origin checks stay exact; the desktop origin is added explicitly, never wildcarded or bypassed.

nodes.label: Configured WSS endpoint or explicit offline mode
nodes.norm_label: configured wss endpoint or explicit offline mode
nodes.rationale: Packaged builds cannot infer ws://game:8080 from the page host; the relay stays separately deployed and builds must set VITE_WS_URL or declare offline mode.

nodes.label: --offline build flag
nodes.rationale: The build deliberately fails unless a secure production wss:// endpoint or explicit offline mode is supplied so an online desktop build never ships misconfigured.

nodes.label: Burn Status
nodes.rationale: 10 damage every 0.5s; reapplication refreshes duration without stacking or delaying the next tick; burn never changes movement/attacks/stun; blocking prevents a move's burn and respawn protection blocks burns.

nodes.label: Illustrated Fire Attacks (painted flame atlases)
nodes.rationale: Flames painted directly around fists and shoes replaced floating hand/foot overlays; renderer keeps body pivots and feet independent of flame bounds.

nodes.label: On Fire (speed aura super)
nodes.rationale: 50% speed boost affects horizontal movement and move startup/active/recovery timing but not jump height or hitstun; fractional attack timing is stored in snapshots for deterministic replay.

nodes.label: Purple Burn (666 Satan status variant)
nodes.rationale: Double-rate burn (20 per 30 ticks for 600 ticks) replaces normal fire without stacking; normal fire cannot downgrade or extend it; protocol 9 carries the variant through rollback.

nodes.label: Audio Bus Graph (Master, Music, SFX, Voice, Critical)
nodes.norm_label: audio bus graph (master, music, sfx, voice, critical)
nodes.rationale: Master feeds a gentle compressor; critical combat (KO/ultimate) has a separate path under SFX so combat ducking does not duck the KO; previously gains were baked into each note so live volume changes did nothing.

nodes.label: Minimal validated fullscreen IPC
nodes.rationale: Only the single DOM fullscreen call in main.ts is replaced; the desktop bridge exposes fullscreen toggle only and validates the main-frame sender.

nodes.label: Narrow safe storage service
nodes.rationale: Only afterglow-controls and abroz-audio-v1 localStorage keys exist; a guarded service keeps identical keys/schema while tolerating unreadable storage.

nodes.label: Independent desktop settings profile
nodes.rationale: Packaged Chromium persists afterglow-controls and abroz-audio-v1 under the app profile at a fixed origin; web and desktop profiles are independent with no migration.

nodes.label: Desktop build pipeline (dist-desktop -> resources/game)
nodes.rationale: One copy of gameplay source and one packaged copy of assets; Vite desktop mode emits dist-desktop/ separately from the web dist/, and the installer never embeds a multiplayer server.

nodes.label: Deterministic Product Sprite Cycle
nodes.rationale: Ten product sprites cycle deterministically so online play has no random-number dependency.

nodes.label: Structure Lifecycle and Snapshot Rules
nodes.rationale: Structures/projectiles clear on owner knockout, forfeit, result or practice reset; timers use simulation frames continuing through hitstop; all structure state lives in snapshots for rollback.

nodes.label: Turret (brick-and-timber cannon)
nodes.rationale: Each cannonball keeps its release direction so later movement can evade it; carriage pitches toward elevated/lower targets; 700 health, 80 seconds.

nodes.label: Your Dream Home (mark-then-build house super)
nodes.rationale: First press marks a persistent location, second press builds for free; house is attackable by everyone including its owner; only active jumping strikes damage the roof, idle head bumps do not; collapse deals 400 damage plus seven-second stun respecting recovery protection.

nodes.label: Chess Knight (mountable summon)
nodes.rationale: 90-frame landing recovery halves air steering and blocks another jump/landing hit, leaving 30 frames of escape after the 60-frame stun; one rider per knight with deterministic seat order for simultaneous mount attempts.

nodes.label: Chess Master (deterministic piece cycle)
nodes.rationale: Piece variant cycles deterministically (pawn, rook, bishop, queen, knight) instead of randomly for rollback safety; 15-second max lifetime prevents orphaned projectiles.

nodes.label: Crying Tree (summon super)
nodes.rationale: Global cap of 10 living tentacles across all owners/spawn sources bounds simulation cost; tree expires after 4,200 frames including hitstop; destruction and timeout share one capped tentacle burst and a snapshot-backed collapse effect.

nodes.label: Football (ricochet projectile)
nodes.rationale: Absolute 180-frame lifetime plus a 12-frame per-target contact cooldown allow repeated hits without damage every tick; friendly contacts bounce without damage.

nodes.label: Two Super Specials per Fighter
nodes.rationale: Full-energy activation with independent once-per-match allowances retained across lives; short keyboard taps are latched until the next input poll.

nodes.label: Invasion Actor Cap (16 total, 8 per side)
nodes.norm_label: invasion actor cap (16 total, 8 per side)
nodes.rationale: Full waves are skipped rather than queued when the cap is reached, bounding simulation cost; grave zombies are outside this cap.

nodes.label: Docker Build and Health Smoke Test
nodes.norm_label: docker build and health smoke test

nodes.label: M4 Clone-growth visual dispose ownership
nodes.rationale: SceneRenderer.dispose traversed mesh materials but never called HairCloneGrowth.dispose, leaking owned textures; fix calls cloneGrowth.dispose and detaches root before generic traversal.

nodes.label: Super Specials (100 energy, once per match)
nodes.norm_label: super specials (100 energy, once per match)

nodes.label: Server Validates and Relays, Not Authoritative
nodes.norm_label: server validates and relays, not authoritative

nodes.label: Server-Distributed Seed and Snapshotted Random State
nodes.norm_label: server-distributed seed and snapshotted random state

nodes.label: Authoritative Result-phase Retention
nodes.rationale: Client completion claims alone no longer bypass inactivity processing; the server-side simulation must be in its result phase.

nodes.label: capacity-staging.ts Isolated Load Runner
nodes.rationale: Owns a local child server on an ephemeral port and accepts no remote targets so it can never load-test production; ramp 2-64 connections with CPU/event-loop/RSS stop conditions.

nodes.label: /connection-status Endpoint
nodes.rationale: Only a failed handshake makes one bounded HTTP request so successful connections incur no extra cost; known capacity/rate/maintenance messages are localized and unknown responses keep the original error.

nodes.label: /healthz and /readyz Aggregate Reporting
nodes.rationale: Reports aggregate counts only; no invite codes, addresses or player identities are exposed.

nodes.label: Lobby Create/Join Token Budget
nodes.rationale: Separate per-socket (burst 10, 20/min) and per-address (burst 128, 120/min, shared across reconnects) budgets limit lobby commands without touching gameplay input rates; generous address burst accommodates simultaneous joins.

nodes.label: server-health Simulation Timing Logs
nodes.rationale: Mean includes executed steps only and socket queues are instantaneous samples, so these metrics do not estimate RTT, CPU per match or safe capacity by themselves.

nodes.label: Cache-Control Policy (hashed vs unhashed assets)
nodes.rationale: index.html and unhashed art/audio need revalidation; only hashed /assets/ bundles are immutable; deploy atomically and keep previous chunks briefly so old HTML never mixes with new assets.

nodes.label: Secrets and VITE_* Policy
nodes.rationale: VITE_* values are embedded in browser code, so only public values belong there; ignore rules do not untrack committed secrets, which must be removed from history and rotated.

nodes.label: Single Relay Instance Constraint
nodes.rationale: Rooms are in-memory, so restarting or scaling across unsynchronized workers loses sessions; use one relay instance or deliberate sticky-session routing.

nodes.label: Disconnect/reconnect policy
nodes.rationale: Identical controller IDs are not reliable serials, so reconnect is an explicit press-based claim; local disconnect pauses, online disconnect only releases local input since the shared simulation cannot pause.

nodes.label: Keyboard coexistence and seat reservation
nodes.rationale: Both original keyboard layouts stay active for P1/P2; using a layout reserves its seat so the first pad joins the next free seat.

nodes.label: Press any button to join
nodes.rationale: A fresh button on an unassigned standard-mapped pad claims a disconnected reserved slot first, then the next free seat; the join press is consumed and movement alone does not join.

nodes.label: Session device key slot assignment
nodes.rationale: Browser gamepad indices and IDs are not stable hardware identities, so slots store per-connection session keys; one pad occupies exactly one slot, disconnected slots stay reserved, nothing persists across refresh.

nodes.label: Menu ownership lease (500ms)
nodes.rationale: Arbitrates simultaneous pads in general menus; sequential 1v1 selection restricts to current player's pad and pause menu belongs to the pausing controller.

nodes.label: Stable focus tokens
nodes.rationale: Per screen/dialog/player tokens restore focus after returning or re-rendering; default focus prefers selected fighters and primary content over header utilities.

nodes.label: Guarded Movement v2 (walk cycle and four-phase backdash)
nodes.norm_label: guarded movement v2 (walk cycle and four-phase backdash)

nodes.label: Bozo Walk v4 Proportion Correction Prompt
nodes.norm_label: bozo walk v4 proportion correction prompt
nodes.rationale: Walking figures in v3 looked too thin and small beside the standing sprite; v4 broadens shoulders 20%, hips 15%, limbs 12%, head 12% while keeping total height and the 4x2 grid.

nodes.label: Bozo Walk v5 Six-pose Alternating Sheet Prompt
nodes.norm_label: bozo walk v5 six-pose alternating sheet prompt
nodes.rationale: Earlier sheets repeated the same leg forward; v5 demands six consecutive poses with genuinely alternating legs and a correction pass for columns 4-6 plus true alpha.

nodes.label: Bozo Hair Clone Movement Sheet Prompt
nodes.norm_label: bozo hair clone movement sheet prompt

nodes.label: Anticipation and Recoil Poses
nodes.rationale: New anticipation/recoil poses for basic attacks preserve existing impact artwork and combat timing; small rigid weight shifts are applied without resizing bodies; generated sheets contain unused candidate frames and only reviewed poses are used.

nodes.label: Ownership Mask Preload
nodes.rationale: Masks are prepared during loading to avoid a first-use animation hitch.

nodes.label: Fractional Clocks in WeakMap
nodes.rationale: Optional fractional clocks are keyed only by disposable display copies so integer simulation clocks and pose selection stay untouched; subtle weight shifts render between ticks without extra art.

nodes.label: RenderInterpolation (continuous root motion)
nodes.rationale: Originally stopped at every state change and throughout attacks, causing discontinuities; now preserves root motion across safe idle/walk/jump/fall transitions and same-move windup/recovery, while impact, beams, dives, grapples and landing stay position-exact. Bounded to one 60 Hz tick of delay.

nodes.label: Simulation-based Cosmetic Time
nodes.rationale: Cosmetic motion (Dodo playing loop, Astolfo breathing, Jomp/Fausto auras) used wall-clock time and kept advancing during pause/hit-stop; SceneRenderer now supplies simulation-based time to fighters and summons while stage effects keep their own clock.

nodes.label: Per-fighter Walk Timing Review
nodes.rationale: Walk rates differ intentionally per fighter (4-8 poses, 5-8 ticks/pose); blanket FPS increases would rush heavy poses without adding artwork, so existing rates were preserved.

nodes.label: Simulation-tick-driven Animation
nodes.rationale: Walk animation is driven by simulation ticks rather than world position so facing changes, rollback corrections and pause never change the pose unexpectedly.

nodes.label: SpriteIsolation (pose ownership masks)
nodes.rationale: Pose rectangles on shared sheets included neighboring artwork, but tightening them would cut hands, feet, flames or beard attacks; the renderer instead labels connected artwork by owning pose and discards neighbors, keeping frame sizes, pivots and timing unchanged. Masks cached per sheet.

nodes.label: Neutral Arena Actors
nodes.rationale: Invaders have no player-owned seat, chase either team, and never count as competitors or win-condition survivors.

nodes.label: M2 Dodo simultaneous lethal pulse trades
nodes.norm_label: m2 dodo simultaneous lethal pulse trades
nodes.rationale: advanceDodo applied damage immediately so earlier seats suppressed later casters' pulses; fix collects contacts before committing damage, matching the shared continuous-attack system.

nodes.label: Spear mode expiry throw (140 damage)
nodes.rationale: Travels the arena, stops on first opposing fighter or clone, ignores allies; defeat does not spawn a throw.

nodes.label: Guard absorbs 60% damage; chip can KO
nodes.norm_label: guard absorbs 60% damage; chip can ko
nodes.rationale: Remaining 40% uses existing armor reductions with whole-point rounding; blocked hits apply no hit-only statuses and do not increase combo count.

nodes.label: Dedicated 16-pose armored combat sheet
nodes.rationale: Action selection happens before outfit selection; armored attacks use their own sheet including empty-handed axe release/catch instead of mapping every attack to two generic poses.

nodes.label: Spin and returning ball hit reactions
nodes.norm_label: spin and returning ball hit reactions
nodes.rationale: Contacts never caused hitstun so training restored damage immediately; now they apply short reactions, combo damage and impact events while keeping periodic spin contact and per-target ball cooldowns.

nodes.label: Drupa rolling (edge-to-edge, hits each opponent once)
nodes.norm_label: drupa rolling (edge-to-edge, hits each opponent once)

nodes.label: Drupa approved portraits v5 / victory v4
nodes.norm_label: drupa approved portraits v5 / victory v4
nodes.rationale: User identified exact originals from screenshots; copied byte-for-byte, superseding the incorrectly selected likeness-v4 set with no regeneration.

nodes.label: Drupa slim-v3 portraits and victory-slim-v2
nodes.rationale: Abdomen and waist girth reduced about 12% by redrawing anatomy rather than squeezing the image, keeping a broad stocky build.

nodes.label: Belly-dive stun presentation (hurt pose + overhead stars)
nodes.norm_label: belly-dive stun presentation (hurt pose + overhead stars)
nodes.rationale: Reuses each fighter's existing hurt pose with sway and three animated stars so no dedicated stunned sprite sheets are needed; stars also work for clones.

nodes.label: Light beam scrolling shader bands
nodes.rationale: Streaks and pulsing width are driven by simulation frames, not wall-clock time.

nodes.label: Music Routing States
nodes.rationale: Selection priority: arena exact-state override, global state/mode track, arena pool, theme-profile pool, default battle track. Sudden-death is a hook with no simulation mechanic. Final intensity when at most two fighters remain with one life each; training excluded.

nodes.label: Contemporary Rooftop Theme
nodes.rationale: Replaced the sci-fi foundry environment with an urban rooftop while keeping internal stage/character IDs stable for compatibility (stage id the-foundry displays as The Rooftop).

nodes.label: Three-life Survival Mode
nodes.rationale: Rounds and timeouts were removed in favor of three lives with an exact 120-tick respawn delay and 120-tick immunity, counted in ticks including hit stop.

nodes.label: Blood Master (transformation mode)
nodes.rationale: Uses the shared damage-protection mechanic (0.9 multiplier) covering melee, projectiles, beams and DoT for 34 seconds; dedicated liquid-coated sprites per skin. Protocol 30.

nodes.label: Shared Dart Muzzle Origin
nodes.rationale: Simulation defines one muzzle origin (125 forward, 145 above feet) and both skin renderers align the blowgun tip to it, so presentation follows simulation rather than the reverse.

nodes.label: Unwanted Touching (bear-hug grapple)
nodes.rationale: Periodic grapple damage deliberately emits no global hitstop so repeated ticks do not pause every fighter; guard, teams and spawn immunity respected; victim released when holder's move breaks, defeat or clone removal.

nodes.label: Companion Hit-stop Exemption
nodes.rationale: Staggered clone hits previously set global hit-stop and repeatedly paused every fighter; companion contacts now keep damage/guard/reactions but create no global hit-stop or strong camera shake. Protocol 8.

nodes.label: Refactor Deliberate Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Preserves the working state machine and specialized mechanic modules; deliberately avoids a single animation engine, a speculative ECS, or claims of automated anatomy validation. Presentation adapters migrate to manifests only as art is updated.

nodes.label: Fighter-identity Dispatch Removal
nodes.rationale: Fighter-name and special move-name branches were removed from shared combat/simulation so behavior is expressed as typed capabilities; proven by a differently named fighter reusing the same abilities and 20 extra registered definitions.

nodes.label: beam.originProfile Metadata
nodes.rationale: A regression check caught a Roms/Drupa beam-origin identity branch; it was replaced by explicit beam.originProfile 'hose' metadata on Roms so shared simulation has no hard-coded fighter identity.

nodes.label: White Buda Complete Rebuild
nodes.rationale: All transformed poses moved to one sixteen-pose atlas with uniform anatomical scale and body pivots, removing runtime switching between separate light and upright sheets. Protocol 24.

nodes.label: Fixed-grip Rigid Spear Shaft
nodes.rationale: Reach comes from illustrated arm extension so the 4.3-unit shaft never slides through Gut's hands; angle stays tied to both hands; no weapon scaling.

nodes.label: White Sprite Bloom Threshold
nodes.rationale: White sprite brightness is kept below the scene bloom threshold to avoid softening pixel outlines.

nodes.label: Held Medium Descending Beam
nodes.rationale: Continuous beam deals 24 damage every 12 ticks with no hitstop, stun or push so it cannot lock opponents; release cancels into recovery; transformation expiry, interruption and defeat end it.

nodes.label: Rigid Spear Revision
nodes.rationale: Replaced stretched weapon meshes with one 4.3m illustrated spear that is only translated/rotated between grips, never deformed or resized, so body and blade proportions stay consistent and hit areas follow the illustrated shaft. Protocol 18.

nodes.label: Presentation-boundary Audio Playback
nodes.community_name: Audio Personality Audit and Roster Follow-up
nodes.rationale: GameAudio runs only at the client presentation boundary after tick(), never inside rollback replay, with bounded event-id suppression. Predicted sounds cannot be undone; confirmed-only playback would add latency, so responsive playback is kept while replay bursts are prevented. Audio never gates gameplay or sends network messages.

nodes.label: Damage Source/Move Journal Metadata
nodes.community_name: Audio Personality Audit and Roster Follow-up
nodes.rationale: Actual damage source, move and block metadata lives in the presentation-only journal, outside snapshots and never read by game rules, so audio can distinguish materials without touching determinism.

nodes.label: GroundImpact Journal Event
nodes.community_name: Audio Personality Audit and Roster Follow-up
nodes.rationale: Fires on actual ground contact including misses; never alters damage or movement. Shared by Nikalz slams and Drupa dive.

nodes.label: Move Phase Audio Profiles (start/active/impact/end)
nodes.community_name: Audio Personality Audit and Roster Follow-up
nodes.rationale: Every registered move has valid phase slots, but short punches do not auto-play active loops or end sounds; impact is emitted by damage/contact, not on a miss; launch and impact must never share one asset.

nodes.label: Locally Generated Procedural PCM Effects
nodes.community_name: Audio Personality Audit and Roster Follow-up
nodes.rationale: Silent material slots were filled with original PCM generated locally (e.g. scripts/create-nikalz-audio.py) without external samples; these are stylized placeholders, not studio foley, and no commercial audio was downloaded.

nodes.label: Projectile Audio Identity Keys
nodes.community_name: Audio Personality Audit and Roster Follow-up
nodes.rationale: Keys include pool slot, owner, serial and move so a burst sharing one attack serial no longer collapses into one lifetime.

nodes.label: Meditation (hold Special 2 healing)
nodes.community_name: Audio Personality Audit and Roster Follow-up
nodes.rationale: Replaced Flying Kung Fu kick; heals 55 HP every 180 simulation ticks while held; interrupted by release/hit/trap/defeat, each hold restarts the interval so it cannot be exploited by rapid re-entry.

nodes.label: Typed Observational Gameplay Events
nodes.community_name: Audio Personality Audit and Roster Follow-up
nodes.rationale: Events are presentation/diagnostic only and suppressed during rollback replay so they never drive gameplay or duplicate effects.
